annotations.text:
A · Editorial spread (chosen)

Now built into the live site. Keeps the split layout and adds the moodboard's system: sun + wordmark lockup, hairline header and footer, tracked captions, and the portrait layered over the ocean photo.

The form here shows the recommended Beehiiv styling; the real form is styled in Beehiiv's form editor.

B · Horizon (not chosen)

The sunrise photo fills the screen and the type sits over it in ivory, with the headline under the real sun. Most immersive; feels like a luxury hotel site.

Tradeoff: legibility depends on the photo, and the ivory brand ground mostly disappears.

C · Brand book (not chosen)

Opens on a huge wordmark with a row of four captioned tiles, like the moodboard itself. Strongest brand presence.

Tradeoff: the wordmark competes with the headline, so it reads more like a brand book than a signup page.
